reason: The simulation cannot run due to an empty main() and broken parse_args(), and several spec-critical metrics and logic are missing or incorrect. With only three iterations left, one more iteration focused on restoring runnability, fixing reproducibility and policy timing, and adding the missing metrics will yield substantial improvement and likely bring the project to spec compliance.

specific_areas: Implement main() to run the simulation end-to-end (CLI parse, optional JSON config, run, save JSON/CSV, optional stdout/plot).
Fix parse_args() to return parser.parse_args() (or parse_known_args) and wire CLI options into main().
Ensure reproducibility by routing all randomness through self.rng (pass rng to adoption_probability and remove global random usage).
Fix policy timing in purchases: purchase_masks_typed(day) uses self.policy.current_state(day); update step() to pass day.
Add missing metrics: time_to_target_adoption (parameterize target_adoption_rate), adoption_inequality_index (Gini by SES), and message_impact (DiD using exposure cohorts).
Parameterize locations: generate num_locations with capacity, mask_policy, and foot_traffic_rate; honor mask_policy_in_locations_fraction and capacities in visit sampling.
Record information exposures per day/agent (exposure_log and ever_exposed) to support message_impact computation.
Add basic error handling for config I/O and result saving; ensure CLI smoke test mode works.

task_understanding.adjustments: Re-align strictly to the original specification: required entities/attributes, required metrics (naming and definitions), and parameter usage. Document any intentional consolidations (e.g., MaskMarket substituting for Retailers) directly in code comments.

data_analysis.adjustments: Define clear cohorting for equity and message impact: SES quintiles for inequality; ever-exposed vs never-exposed for DiD with a configurable reference day. Parameterize target_adoption_rate and ensure windowing choices (e.g., 7-day pre/post) are explicit and configurable.

model_planning.adjustments: Prioritize runnability and reproducibility fixes first; then implement minimal yet spec-compliant location parameterization and metrics. If time permits, add an EpidemiologicalContext stub; otherwise leave hooks and parameters in place.

code_generation.adjustments: Implement main() and fix parse_args(); pass day into purchase logic; pass rng into adoption_probability; extend Location with capacity/mask_policy/foot_traffic_rate; track exposures; compute Gini and DiD metrics; add target_adoption_rate parameter.

code_verification.adjustments: Add a smoke test path: run with small N and T via CLI flags; verify deterministic outputs for a fixed seed (run twice, compare key metrics); assert required metrics exist in results. Check that num_locations and mask_policy_in_locations_fraction are used.

simulation_execution.adjustments: Ensure run() executes all steps daily, calls purchase_masks_typed(day), saves outputs, and optionally visualizes. Add try/except for config parsing and file writes with clear warnings.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Compute and return: adoption_rate_over_time, final_adoption_rate, time_to_target_adoption (with target_adoption_rate), adoption_inequality_index (Gini by SES), message_impact (DiD), and existing compliance/unmet demand metrics. Validate naming matches the spec.

feedback_generation.adjustments: Include a concise change log highlighting fixes to CLI/main, RNG reproducibility, policy-day bug, new metrics, and location parameterization. Provide brief notes on any remaining divergences and planned resolution in subsequent iterations.
